# @npv12/opencode-footer

Minimal OpenCode TUI plugin that shows a `↓ N` count of active subagents and shells in the prompt footer. Hides when nothing is running.

## Features

- Shows `↓ N` where N is the total count of running subagents + active shells
- Updates in real-time as subagents start/finish and shells open/close
- Automatically hides when count reaches zero

## Installation

```bash
opencode plugin add @npv12/opencode-footer
```

Or add to your `cli.json`:

```json
{
  "plugins": ["@npv12/opencode-footer"]
}
```
